title: 26 U.S.C. 731, Extent of recognition of gain or loss on distribution (U.S. Code 2024 edition)
issuer: U.S. Government Publishing Office, United States Code

passages.question: Do the June 30, 2026 cash distributions create gain for a partner?
passages.excerpt: gain shall not be recognized to such partner, except to the extent that any money distributed exceeds the adjusted basis of such partner's interest in the partnership immediately before the distribution
